accepted.name: subject_offered_core
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  subject_offered.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY,
  subject_offered.TERM_CODE,
  subject_offered.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER,
  subject_offered.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER_SORT,
  subject_offered.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER_DESC,
  subject_offered.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
  subject_offered.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT,
  subject_offered.COURSE_NUMBER,
  subject_offered.COURSE_NUMBER_SORT,
  subject_offered.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC,
  subject_offered.SUBJECT_ID,
  subject_offered.SUBJECT_ID_SORT,
  subject_offered.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  subject_offered.SECTION_ID,
  subject_offered.IS_MASTER_SECTION,
  subject_offered.IS_LECTURE_SECTION,
  subject_offered.IS_LAB_SECTION,
  subject_offered.IS_RECITATION_SECTION,
  subject_offered.IS_DESIGN_SECTION,
  subject_offered.OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
  subject_offered.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
  subject_offered.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME,
  subject_offered.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
  subject_offered.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID,
  subject_offered.MEET_TIME,
  subject_offered.MEET_PLACE,
  subject_offered.CLUSTER_TYPE,
  subject_offered.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC,
  subject_offered.CLUSTER_LIST,
  subject_offered.HGN_CODE,
  subject_offered.HGN_CODE_DESC,
  subject_offered.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER,
  subject_offered.CLUSTER_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER,
  subject_offered.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE,
  subject_offered.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,
  subject_offered.IS_REPEATABLE_SUBJECT
FROM subject_offered
accepted.description: Core subject_offered rows with key identifiers and common descriptive and enrollment columns. Use this to filter subjects by TERM_CODE, SUBJECT_ID, OFFER_DEPT_CODE, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID, or enrollment counts. | Use for: List sections for a term/department/faculty; Filter subjects by enrollment counts or attributes; Join to instructor or department tables for enrichment

accepted.name: subject_offered_enrollment_rank
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  subject_offered.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY,
  subject_offered.TERM_CODE,
  subject_offered.SUBJECT_ID,
  subject_offered.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  subject_offered.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,
  RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY subject_offered.TERM_CODE ORDER BY COALESCE(subject_offered.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,0) DESC) AS enrollment_rank
FROM subject_offered
accepted.description: Per TERM_CODE ranking of subject_offered by NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS with an explicit rank column. Use this to pick top-k subjects per term by filtering on rank. | Use for: Find top-enrolled subjects per term; Investigate enrollment distribution across terms; Select top-k rows per TERM_CODE for downstream joins

accepted.name: subject_offered_with_faculty
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  subject_offered.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY,
  subject_offered.TERM_CODE,
  subject_offered.SUBJECT_ID,
  subject_offered.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  subject_offered.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID,
  subject_offered.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
  employee_directory.MIT_ID,
  employee_directory.LAST_NAME,
  employee_directory.FIRST_NAME,
  employee_directory.FULL_NAME,
  employee_directory.OFFICE_LOCATION,
  employee_directory.OFFICE_PHONE,
  employee_directory.EMAIL_ADDRESS
FROM subject_offered
LEFT JOIN employee_directory ON employee_directory.MIT_ID = subject_offered.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID
accepted.description: Denormalized subject_offered joined to employee_directory (faculty) via RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID to expose faculty names/contact info alongside course rows. Useful when combining course sections with faculty attributes. | Use for: List courses with faculty contact details; Filter courses by faculty office or department; Assess faculty teaching loads by joining to subject_offered
